Examples

Real pages built with Actual CSS - an admin application and a set of standalone templates - to see the primitives, components, and patterns composed the way they are meant to be used.

The examples live in the repository under demo/ and load the shipped bundles from dist/ (actual.full.css, actual-themes.min.css, actual.full.js), referenced with stable URLs.

Admin application

demo/admini/ is a complete admin interface: application shell, navigation, tables, forms, dialogs, and feedback states.

  • Dashboard - app shell, navbar, stat cards, charts, recent activity
  • Login - centered auth card with social actions
  • Forms - inputs, choice cards, validation, joined controls, sticky actions
  • Tables - data tables, status badges, bulk actions
  • Kanban - drag-free column layout with cards
  • Chat - conversation list, message thread, composer
  • Calendar - month grid with event cards
  • Invoice - structured document layout
  • Profile - avatar, tabs, settings rows
  • Settings - grouped settings with switches
  • User grid - avatar grid, filters, pagination
  • 404 - empty state

Templates

demo/templates/ are standalone pages covering common page shapes.

  • Kitchen sink - every component and variant on one page
  • Keyboard controls - hands-on keyboard support matrix and focus test bench
  • Surface contracts - .inverted, cascade precedence, and the intent boundary
  • Dashboard - data-heavy overview page
  • App - application shell with sidebar
  • Marketing - landing page with typography and fluid type
  • Blog - article page with prose
  • Blocks - layout building blocks
  • Layout reference - canonical compositions built only with the layout primitives
  • Density - compact control density

Note: the examples reference the repository's source files, so they open from the checkout, not from a standalone copy of site.
